normalization.purpose: Research observations, not product certification or a typed-case implementation.

placeholders.<REPO>: Canonical checkout root used for the experiment.
placeholders.<RUN_DIR>: Canonical raw evidence root, including fixture projects and isolated cache.
placeholders.<BUN>: Bun executable recorded by the experiment.
placeholders.<HOME>: The exporter's home directory, if present in captured text.

transformations: Only known machine paths are replaced in argv, cwd, output, observation metadata, and native logs; all other output text and all exit codes are retained.
Inherited PATH is omitted. Remaining identical environment overrides are recorded once in metadata, rather than repeated for every subprocess.
Fixture file contents are not normalized: publication fails if that would be necessary. Identical content and identical manifests are deduplicated.
Timestamps, process IDs, durations, Git identities, runtime versions, content hashes, and positive/negative outcomes are preserved from the run.
normalization.fixtureHashDefinition: A blob key is SHA-256 of the original UTF-8 file text. A rawFixtureSha256 is SHA-256 of JSON.stringify of the ordered relative-path-to-text object before the command. Manifest files retain that insertion order, so reconstructing the object from blobs reproduces the recorded hash.
normalization.manifestHashDefinition: A manifest key is SHA-256 of JSON.stringify({rawFixtureSha256, emptyDirectories, files}), where files maps project-relative paths to blob keys in original order. Recreate the recorded empty directories as well as parent directories for files. Git internals are excluded; the recorded Git commands recreate the fixture history.
normalization.observationHashScope: Source file hashes in observations (including probe 24) remain hashes of the original exact bytes; paths are not included in those hashes.
normalization.pathAudit: Export rejects remaining known private roots and common Unix/Windows user or temporary directory paths. Inspect before publishing on another environment.

metadata.timeoutScope: Direct subprocess; no cross-platform descendant-process termination guarantee. A timeout stops the suite.

outcomes.label: 19-status-after-behavior-regression
outcomes.observation: Status records scoped source drift but does not rerun the behavioral target or validate prior evidence freshness.

outcomes.label: 24-two-distinct-dirty-trees-share-vcs-identity
outcomes.observation: Different comment bytes yield different source hashes while executable behavior stays identical; HEAD + branch + dirty flag does not identify exact uncommitted bytes.

outcomes.label: 28-metadata-captures-start-not-post-command-tree
outcomes.observation: A passing child and clean starting identity do not guarantee unchanged source after that child exits.
